engines.name: FFmpeg LGPL (Linux x86-64)
engines.description: Static BtbN Linux x86-64 build for common audio and video conversion; GPL-only x264 and x265 encoders are excluded.

engines.name: JPEG XL tools (Linux x86-64)
engines.description: Static JPEG XL command-line tools from the libjxl project.

engines.name: LibreOffice document runtime (Linux x86-64)
engines.description: Managed adapter for the exact Debian runtime in the document Worker image. Requires Dockerfile.worker; installation does not download a system package.

engines.name: Poppler document runtime (Linux x86-64)
engines.description: Managed adapter for the exact Debian runtime in the document Worker image. Requires Dockerfile.worker; installation does not download a system package.

profiles.name: FFmpeg Audio/Video Conversion
profiles.description: Common audio and video transcoding and target-size compression using a shared FFmpeg engine installation.

profiles.name: FFmpeg Image Conversion
profiles.description: Common raster image conversion through the pinned LGPL FFmpeg build. AVIF support depends on the capabilities compiled into that release.

profiles.name: FFmpeg Image Conversion
profiles.description: Verified raster image conversion through the pinned LGPL FFmpeg build. Still-image targets take the first frame; WebP and GIF preserve animation. AVIF is encoded as a single still image.

profiles.name: JPEG XL Image Conversion
profiles.description: Encode JPEG, PNG, APNG, and GIF images as JPEG XL with adjustable quality; decode JPEG XL to JPEG or PNG.

profiles.name: FFmpeg Audio/Video Compression
profiles.description: FFmpeg Audio/Video Compression settings using the shared ffmpeg engine installation.

profiles.name: JPEG XL Image Compression
profiles.description: JPEG XL Image Compression settings using the shared jpeg-xl engine installation.

profiles.name: FFmpeg Image Compression
profiles.description: Verified JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF image compression through the pinned LGPL FFmpeg build. Output keeps the source pixel dimensions; AVIF is encoded as a still image.

profiles.name: Office Documents to PDF
profiles.description: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF and text to PDF. Requires the document Worker image. Fonts may be substituted; review complex layouts. Password-protected documents are unsupported.

profiles.name: PDF Rendering & Text Extraction
profiles.description: Render one chosen PDF page to PNG/JPEG, or extract UTF-8 text. Scanned PDFs require OCR, which is not included. Encrypted PDFs are unsupported. Requires the document Worker image.
